verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM can be self-hosted via Docker and exposes API access/keys plus a custom agent skill developer guide, which together enable non-interactive, scriptable automation suitable for CI-like use. However, there is no explicit documentation of a headless/CLI mode, CI pipeline examples, or automated test/deployment guidance. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CLI flags, CI integration examples, and independent confirmation of running unattended in automation pipelines.
